video.title: Transfers Your Club Should AVOID This Summer! | Sunday Vibes
video.description:
Hello and welcome back to Sunday Vibes where today we are discussing transfers your club should AVOID this summer!

From Lamine Yamal's rumoured world record move to PSG, Jaden Philogene being chased by Barcelona, Anthony Gordon and the links with Liverpool, Ricardo Calafiori being scouted by Arsenal and Chelsea and so much more!

Enjoy the video? Remember to like it, leave a comment and subscribe to Football Daily for more great content!

27:50-32:27 Rabiot to Liverpool
32:28-40:11 McKennie to Spurs
40:12-43:07 Yamal to PSG

46:18-48:51 Trafford to Newcastle
